name: Slate
description: The workspace: notes, subscriptions and product metrics in one place.
notes: The Workspace has its own icon in the sidebar.
Today: your figures as a strip with the budget as a bar under them, and the lists over two columns with room for every task
One plus at the top right for logging a payment, adding a subscription, a new note or asking the assistant
Page titles stand alone, without the circle beside them
On a Mac, Slate now reads your vault, so the Learning routine shows on Today and syncs to your phone
